---
title: "cytoJointR pilot benchmark"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
execute:
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: parameters
# Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN_DIR <- Sys.getenv("PILOT_RUN_DIR", "runs/2026-11-02_pilot")  # replicates and scenarios.tsv, relative to the repo root
SUMMARY_DIR <- Sys.getenv("PILOT_SUMMARY_DIR", "runs/2026-11-02_pilot-summary-v2")  # 04_summarise-pilot.R tables
SCORES_SHOWN <- c("RMS", "poly_absolute", "poly_marginal", "CPS", "CCS", "breadth")
COVERAGE_TARGET <- 0.9  # nominal interval level
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
})
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 8))
read_run <- \(f) read_tsv(file.path(here::here(SUMMARY_DIR), f), show_col_types = FALSE)
# Replicates of the summarised stage only: the done rows of replicate_status.tsv.
done_dirs <- read_run("replicate_status.tsv") |>
  filter(done) |>
  mutate(dir = file.path(here::here(RUN_DIR), "reps", scenario_id, sprintf("seed_%02d", seed))) |>
  pull(dir)
read_reps <- \(f) {
  file.path(done_dirs, f) |>
    keep(file.exists) |>
    map(\(x) read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(donor_id = "c"))) |>
    list_rbind()
}
scenarios <- read_tsv(file.path(here::here(RUN_DIR), "scenarios.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
scenario_levels <- scenarios$scenario_id
metrics <- read_run("metrics_scores.tsv") |>
  filter(score %in% SCORES_SHOWN) |>
  mutate(scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels),
         score = fct(score, levels = SCORES_SHOWN))
# Per-replicate rates: one point per seed over the summary.
reps <- read_reps("score_recovery.tsv") |>
  filter(score %in% SCORES_SHOWN) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE), bias = mean(estimate - truth, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(scenario_id, model, score, seed)) |>
  mutate(scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels),
         score = fct(score, levels = SCORES_SHOWN))
```

## Completion

Every scenario and seed that finished is listed here; a missing one is a failed task.

```{r}
read_run("replicate_status.tsv") |>
  summarise(expected = n(), done = sum(done), .by = scenario_id) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Coverage

Each score's 90% interval covers the true score about as often as its nominal level, except where the point and its error bar fall away from the dashed line (grey points are single seeds; black points are the mean with a binomial MC SE of one standard error).

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
plot_cov <- metrics |>
  filter(model == "full")
ggplot(plot_cov, aes(coverage, scenario_id)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reps, model == "full"), aes(x = coverage), colour = "grey60",
             alpha = 0.5, size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = coverage - coverage_mcse, xmax = coverage + coverage_mcse), size = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = COVERAGE_TARGET, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(score), nrow = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Coverage of the 90% interval (fraction of contrasts)", y = NULL)
```

## Bias

Bias is the posterior-mean error against the true score on the fraction scale (grey points are single seeds; black points are the mean over seeds with one MC SE).

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(plot_cov, aes(bias, scenario_id)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(reps, model == "full"), aes(x = bias), colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.5,
             size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = bias - bias_mcse, xmax = bias + bias_mcse), size = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(score), nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Bias (estimate - truth, fraction scale)", y = NULL)
```

## False sign rate

A false sign is P(score > epsilon) above 0.95 while the true score is at most 0, shown with a binomial MC SE over the seeds that have such a contrast.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(filter(metrics, model == "full", !is.na(false_sign_rate)), aes(false_sign_rate, scenario_id)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = pmax(0, false_sign_rate - false_sign_mcse),
                      xmax = false_sign_rate + false_sign_mcse), size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(vars(score), nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "False sign rate (fraction of contrasts with truth <= 0)", y = NULL)
```

## Visit change

The visit-change table has the same metrics at donor and population level, shown for the visit-change scenarios.

```{r}
read_run("metrics_visit_change.tsv") |>
  filter(grepl("visit_change", scenario_id), score %in% c("RMS", "poly_absolute", "CPS")) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  select(scenario_id, model, level, score, n_reps, bias, bias_mcse, rmse, coverage, coverage_mcse) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Ablation

Dropping the donor-by-visit deviation (`no_donor_visit`) is compared with the full model on the visit-change scenarios, with each seed a point.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.5
abl <- read_reps("visit_change_recovery.tsv") |>
  filter(grepl("visit_change", scenario_id), level == "donor", score %in% c("RMS", "poly_absolute", "CPS")) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(scenario_id, model, score, seed))
ggplot(abl, aes(model, coverage)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = COVERAGE_TARGET, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(scenario_id ~ score) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Donor-level visit-change coverage (fraction of donors)")
```

## Diagnostics

R-hat, ESS, divergences and fit time per replicate, with the usual thresholds (R-hat 1.01, ESS 400) dashed.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
diag_long <- read_reps("diagnostics.tsv") |>
  filter(model == "full") |>
  mutate(scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, n_divergent, fit_seconds), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
ref <- tibble(metric = c("max_rhat", "min_ess_bulk"), v = c(1.01, 400))
ggplot(diag_long, aes(value, scenario_id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.6, position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_vline(data = ref, aes(xintercept = v), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(vars(metric), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

## Mixing flags

Replicates with R-hat above 1.01, bulk ESS below 400 or any divergence are flagged, kept in every metric above, and counted here (the `no_dv` scenario is data without donor-by-visit variation fitted with the donor-by-visit term).

```{r}
read_run("metrics_diagnostics.tsv") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  select(scenario_id, model, n_reps, n_reps_bad_mixing, n_reps_divergent, max_rhat, min_ess_bulk,
         median_fit_seconds) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## COMPASS

COMPASS FS and PFS (seeds 1-5) are plotted against the true RMS and true polyfunctional net frequency of the same contrasts, next to the cytoJointR estimate.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
cmp <- read_run("compass_comparison.tsv") |>
  pivot_longer(c(compass_FS, compass_PFS, estimate_RMS), names_to = "quantity", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(truth = if_else(quantity == "compass_PFS", truth_poly_absolute, truth_RMS))
ggplot(cmp, aes(truth, value, colour = quantity)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(scenario_id), scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "True score (RMS; poly_absolute for PFS)", y = "Estimate or COMPASS score")
```
